messages:
dan_pm: OK team — aiming to start a region-by-region rollout for v3.2.1 at 15:00 UTC. Plan: US canary (5 -> 25 -> 100), wait 30m between steps; if healthy, cut EU after +2h, APAC last after EU. Need capacity thumbs and any hard pins/rollback rules.

deploy-bot: queued deploy request received for version v3.2.1. Canary groups: us-canary (us-west/us-east), eu-canary (eu-west), apac-canary (ap-south/ap-northeast). Rollout steps configured: 5%, 25%, 100%. Auto-rollback hooks enabled.

dan_pm: tagging SRE + infra — @tariq_sre @kai_infra @mary_eng please confirm headroom & expected warmup times. Also want the pinned variant set for Dedicated pools in US/EU.

mary_eng: US capacity check: we have ~1.2k spare token/sec after warmup on reserved pools. Warmup expected 12–15 minutes for new model image. Recommend canary qps cap = 120 to avoid thermal spike. :thumbsup:

tariq_sre: EU note: only 2 spare GPU nodes in eu-west during change window (14:30–18:00 UTC). Suggest smaller EU canary steps: 3% -> 10% -> 30% with 45m holds. If we see >80% mem or tail p95 > 1.2x baseline, trigger rollback.

lucy_ops: APAC maintenance ends at 16:30 UTC; ops won't approve APAC start until 17:00 UTC local. We should not schedule APAC earlier. Also FYI the APAC NAT gateway quota is near 90% used — possible external call throttles.

nora_releases: Release notes live: https://internal.redwood/release/3.2.1 — highlights: improved KV cache eviction, quantization tweaks for smaller memory, bugfix for chat turn attribution. 'Known issues' section notes potential slight perf variance on some old AMIs. Add a short user-facing blurb?

kai_infra: Pin request acknowledged. I'll pin v3.2.1 on Dedicated pool tags: redwood-dedicated-us, redwood-dedicated-eu. APAC pin pending until ops green. Pin action: `infractl pin --pool redwood-dedicated-us --version v3.2.1` executed in staging; will run in prod at canary start.

ben_ml: If EU GPU pressure is an issue, we have a lighter quantized fallback: v3.2.1-q (smaller memory footprint, slightly lower perf). Recommend enabling auto-fallback based on mem pressure threshold.

deploy-bot: registered fallback variant v3.2.1-q. Fallback policy: trigger if node mem_util > 85% OR p95_latency > 1.2x baseline across canary slice for 3 consecutive minutes. Fallback is non-rolling (switch per-request routing to variant).

dan_pm: Good. Finalize canary step durations: US holds = 30m; EU holds = 45m; APAC holds = 30m. Rollback triggers: any 5% increase in error-rate or 20% drop in success throughput vs baseline at the end of a hold. Confirm?

tariq_sre: Confirmed. Also add thermal throttling check in US: if GPU temp spike correlates with latency, auto-throttle to 50% traffic and alert oncall.

mary_eng: One more perf note — the new KV eviction reduces cold-starts but increases prefix cache misses on long-horizon sessions. Watch tail-latency for sessions >10k tokens.

lucy_ops: Scheduling note: shift handoff for APAC will be me -> aya_ops at 16:45 UTC. I'll post a final GO/NO-GO at 16:55 UTC.

deply-bot: (bot) typo fixed: deploy-bot: starting canary only after explicit /deploy start command from release owner.

dan_pm: I'll run the deploy at 15:00 UTC for US. Commands I'll run (posting for audit):
```
/deploy start --env prod --version v3.2.1 --regions us --canary 5,25,100 --hold 30m --pin true
```

ben_ml: if EU fallback triggers, make sure telemetry tags the fallback path for evaluation. Add tag: `fallback_variant=v3.2.1-q`.

nora_releases: Adding fallback note to release notes and to the rollout checklist. Also attaching release checklist: https://internal.redwood/checklists/rollout-3.2.1.

kai_infra: After US canary completes, I'll promote pins for EU (manual due to small pool). APAC pin deferred until post-maintenance.

dan_pm: OK — summary: US go at 15:00 UTC (dan runs /deploy), US holds 30m between steps; EU starts after +2h with smaller steps/longer holds, APAC after EU and only after lucy ops GO. Auto-fallback to v3.2.1-q enabled. Rollback triggers and thermal checks set. I'll post final release thread 10m before start. Thanks. :rocket:
